hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: बचपन की याद
stanzas: अब माँ बनी, देखी अपनी छब्बी अपनी राज कुमारी मैं
तैयारी कर रही उसकी बिदाई की मैं….
होते थे तू तू मैं मैं दादी से या माँ से
रूठ के कमरे में छूप जाती किसी कोने में …
भोजन की थाली लेके माँ आती कमरे में
नख़रे थे मेरे ,मुस्कुराके मना लेती मुझे कमरे में…..
माँ की याद आयी आँखों से अक्ष बहाने लगे
बिदाई में बाबूजी ए सिर पर हाथ रख बिदाई देने लगे।
आज एक माँ को माँ की याद आयी
दिल पर पत्थर रख बेटी को

en.label: English
en.title: Memories of Childhood
stanzas: how happy my heart used to be.
Now a mother, I see my own reflection in my little princess;
I am preparing to bid her farewell….
I used to quarrel with Grandma or Mother,
and sulk, hiding in some corner of my room…
Mother would come into the room carrying a plate of food;
for all my fuss, she would smile and coax me back…..
I remembered Mother, and tears began to flow;
at my farewell, Father laid his hand upon my head and let me go.
Today a mother remembered her own mother;
with a stone upon her heart, she sent her daughter
The flower of my father’s courtyard
found its place in someone else’s bouquet.

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ପିଲାଦିନର ସ୍ମୃତି
stanzas: ଏବେ ନିଜେ ମାଆ ହେଲି, ମୋ ରାଜକୁମାରୀଠାରେ ନିଜର ଛବି ଦେଖିଲି,
ତାକୁ ବିଦାୟ ଦେବାର ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି କରୁଛି ମୁଁ….
ଜେଜେମାଆ କି ମାଆ ସହ ହେଉଥିଲା ଯୁକ୍ତିତର୍କ,
ଅଭିମାନ କରି ଘରର କେଉଁ କୋଣରେ ଲୁଚିଯାଉଥିଲି…
ଖାଇବା ଥାଳି ଧରି ମାଆ ଆସୁଥିଲା ଘରକୁ,
ମୋର କେତେ ନଖରା, ହସିହସି ମୋ ମାନ ଭାଙ୍ଗୁଥିଲା ସେହି ଘରେ…..
ମାଆ କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ିଲା, ଆଖିରୁ ଲୁହ ବୋହିଲା,
ବିଦାୟ ବେଳେ ବାପା ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ହାତ ରଖି ମୋତେ ବିଦାୟ ଦେଲେ।
ଆଜି ଜଣେ ମାଆର ନିଜ ମାଆ କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ିଲା,

illustration.alt: Watercolor of a meal on a steel plate beside a shaded room and a warm red threshold.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: इश्क़ ही मेरा खुदा
stanzas: किनारा तो नज़र आना ही है ।।
तुम्हारे बैगेयर ज़िन्दगी के मैयाने अधूरे हैं।
खुदा की दी ये ज़िंदगी है,
जिससे दवा की ज़रूरत ना हो।।
मेरे इश्क़ को मुझे ना होने देना जुदा ।।

en.label: English
en.title: Love Alone Is My God
stanzas: Now I have committed the sin
Why fear if a flood should come
I am the shore of love
A bank is bound to come in sight.
Without you, the meanings of life are incomplete.
Through you alone there is life
Through you alone there is devotion.
Yet what sort of life is this
What sort of tale is it where
What sort of love is that
What sort of ailment is that
Which has no need of a remedy?
Grant this much kindness, O God
Do not let my love be parted from me.

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ପ୍ରେମ ହିଁ ମୋର ଈଶ୍ୱର
stanzas: ମୋ ପ୍ରେମକୁ ମୋଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅ ନାହିଁ।

illustration.alt: An open blank notebook and a fountain pen on folded cotton.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: ख़फ़ा हैं हम
stanzas: मुद्दत बाद जो याद किया हमें
यूँ लगा डूबते को सहारा दिया तुमने
कभी सोचो कैसे गुजारे लम्हे तेरे बिना
तेरे बिना भी तेरे साथ जिया हमने।
हवा के झोंके के संग आते और पोर-पोर उतर जाते
सदियों बीत गये तुम्हारी ख़ुशबू को महसूस किए
वक्त के साथ हवाओं का भी रुख़ बदल दिया तुमने
क्या जानो एक-एक पल बिन तुम्हारे कैसे गुजारी हमने।
ख़फ़ा हैं हम तुमसे भी संगदिल और ख़ुदा से भी
सिद्दत से इश्क किया, इश्क को खुदा माना हमने
फिर हमसे हमारे ख़ुदा को ही गुमनाम किया तुमने
क्या जानो एक-एक पल बिन तुम्हारे कैसे गुजारी हमने।
करवट लेते - लेते गुज़रती हैं मेरी हर रात
बिस्तर पर तन्हाईयां है और है तुम्हारी बात
मोहब्बत में न जाने कौन सी सजा दी है तुमने
की बहते अश्कों में भी तुम्हें देखा है हमने।

en.label: English
en.title: I Am Hurt
stanzas: When you remembered me after so long,
it felt as though you had saved one drowning.
Think sometimes how I passed those moments without you;
even without you, I lived with you.
You came with the wind's gust and sank into every pore.
Ages have passed since I felt your fragrance.
With time you changed even the direction of the winds;
what do you know of how I passed each moment without you?
I am hurt by you, hard-hearted one, and by God too.
I loved intensely; I regarded love as God.
Then you made my own God nameless to me.
What do you know of how I passed each moment without you?
Every night of mine passes in turning from side to side;
on the bed there is loneliness, and talk of you.
Who knows what punishment you have given me in love,
for even in flowing tears I have seen you.

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ମୁଁ ଅଭିମାନ କରିଛି
stanzas: ଏତେଦିନ ପରେ ମୋତେ ମନେ ପକାଇଲ ଯେ,
କେବେ ଭାବ, ତୁମ ବିନା କିପରି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ କାଟିଲି;
ତୁମ ବିନା ବି ତୁମ ସହ ବଞ୍ଚିଲି।
ପବନର ଝଲକ ସହ ଆସୁଥିଲ, ପୋରେ ପୋରେ ଓହ୍ଲାଉଥିଲ।
ତୁମ ବାସ୍ନା ଅନୁଭବ କରିବାର ଯୁଗ ବିତିଗଲା।
ସମୟ ସହ ପବନର ଦିଗ ବି ବଦଳାଇଦେଲ;
ତୁମ ବିନା ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଷଣ କିପରି କାଟିଲି, ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ଜାଣ?
ତୁମ ଉପରେ ଅଭିମାନ, ପାଷାଣହୃଦୟ, ଈଶ୍ୱରଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ବି।
ମନପ୍ରାଣରେ ପ୍ରେମ କଲି, ପ୍ରେମକୁ ଈଶ୍ୱର ମାନିଲି।
ପୁଣି ମୋ ଈଶ୍ୱରଙ୍କୁ ମୋ ପାଇଁ ନାମହୀନ କରିଦେଲ।
ତୁମ ବିନା ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଷଣ କିପରି କାଟିଲି, ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ଜାଣ?
କଡ଼ ଲେଉଟାଇ ଲେଉଟାଇ ମୋର ପ୍ରତି ରାତି ବିତେ;
ବିଛଣାରେ ଏକାକୀତ୍ୱ ଅଛି, ଆଉ ତୁମ କଥା।

illustration.alt: Old clothbound books, a dried leaf and a cotton bookmark.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: हमसे हो दूर तुम
stanzas: इश्क के नशे की शराब हो तुम।।
इश्क होगा तुम्हें भी कभी हमसे
हमारे इश्क में डूब जाओगे तुम ।।
निगाहें टिकी रहती हैं तेरे दीदार के वास्ते ।।
कभी सपनों में आके हमे छू लेना।।

en.label: English
en.title: You Are Far from Me
stanzas: you are the wine of love's intoxication.
Someday you too may love me—
You will drown in my love.
my eyes remain fixed, longing for a glimpse of you.
Come sometime in dreams and touch me.

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ତୁମେ ମୋଠାରୁ ଦୂରରେ
stanzas: ଦିନେ ତୁମର ବି ମୋ ପ୍ରତି ପ୍ରେମ ହେବ,
ତୁମ ଦର୍ଶନ ପାଇଁ ଆଖି ଲାଖି ରହେ।

illustration.alt: Old clothbound books, a dried leaf and a cotton bookmark.

en.label: English
en.title: I have seen love turning into hatred,
stanzas: I have seen the moon hiding its face in the clouds of sorrows.
I have seen a flowing reflection even in happiness,
I have seen hiding the reflection in sorrow.
I have seen a paper boat smiling,
I have seen expensive toys crying too.
I have seen dreams being fulfilled in huts,
I have seen dreams being buried in palaces.
I have seen white drapes being colored in red colour,
I have seen colorful drapes transforming into whiteness.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: मैंने प्रेम को घृणा में बदलते देखा है,
stanzas: मैंने दुखों के बादलों में चाँद को चेहरा छिपाते देखा है।
मैंने ख़ुशी में भी बहता प्रतिबिंब देखा है,
मैंने दुख में प्रतिबिंब को छिपते देखा है।
मैंने काग़ज़ की नाव को मुस्कुराते देखा है,
मैंने महँगे खिलौनों को भी रोते देखा है।
मैंने झोपड़ियों में सपने पूरे होते देखे हैं,
मैंने महलों में सपने दफ़न होते देखे हैं।
मैंने सफ़ेद वस्त्रों को लाल रंग में रँगते देखा है,
मैंने रंगीन वस्त्रों को सफ़ेदी में बदलते देखा है।

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରେମକୁ ଘୃଣାରେ ବଦଳିବା ଦେଖିଛି,
stanzas: ମୁଁ ଦୁଃଖର ମେଘରେ ଜହ୍ନକୁ ମୁହଁ ଲୁଚାଇବା ଦେଖିଛି।
ମୁଁ ସୁଖରେ ବି ବହୁଥିବା ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ଦେଖିଛି,
ମୁଁ ଦାମିକା ଖେଳନାକୁ ବି କାନ୍ଦିବା ଦେଖିଛି।
ମୁଁ କୁଡ଼ିଆରେ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ସଫଳ ହେବା ଦେଖିଛି,
ମୁଁ ଧଳା ବସ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ରଙ୍ଗିବା ଦେଖିଛି,
ମୁଁ ରଙ୍ଗିନ ବସ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଧଳାରେ ବଦଳିବା ଦେଖିଛି।

illustration.alt: An open blue window looks onto reeds, water and a distant horizon.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: न शिकायत है, न शिकवा है।
stanzas: न शिकायत है, न शिकवा है।
फ़क्र है मुझे एक फौजी की बीवी होने का।
पर दिल तो है एक औरत का....
रखना अपना और अपनों का ख़्याल तुम।।
बूढ़ी माँ को बड़ी आसानी से गाँव ले जाने का वादा कर गए थे तुम।
और गाँव ले जाएगा बेटा कभी ..
फ़र्ज़ अदा करने को आया जब,
है तू अपने देश का वीर ....
दे गए आंखों में झूठे वादे।
न शिकायत है न शिकवा है,
फ़क्र एक फौजी की बीवी होने का है।
पर दिल तो एक औरत का है ....
भूल गए बच्चों के वादे तुम,
बूढ़ी माँ के आंसू को गाँव ले गये तुम।
सफेद रंग मुझे तोहफा में दे गए तुम।।

or.label: ଓଡ଼ିଆ
or.title: ନା ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅଛି, ନା ଅଭିମାନ
stanzas: ଜଣେ ସୈନିକର ପତ୍ନୀ ହୋଇଥିବାର ଗର୍ବ ଅଛି ମୋର।
ନିଜର ଓ ଆପଣାର ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଯତ୍ନ ନେବ ତୁମେ।।
ବୁଢ଼ୀ ମାଆକୁ ଅତି ସହଜରେ ଗାଁକୁ ନେବାର ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା କରିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।
ଜଣେ ସୈନିକର ପତ୍ନୀ ହେବାର ଗର୍ବ ଅଛି।
ବୁଢ଼ୀ ମାଆର ଲୁହକୁ ଗାଁକୁ ନେଇଗଲ ତୁମେ।
ଧଳା ରଙ୍ଗ ମୋତେ ଉପହାର ଦେଇଗଲ ତୁମେ।।

en.label: English
en.title: Neither Complaint nor Grievance
stanzas: I have neither complaint nor grievance.
I am proud to be a soldier’s wife.
But mine is a woman’s heart....
How can I hide the state of this aching heart?
you went away telling a lie.
I shall put red bangles on your wrists.
look after yourself and our loved ones.
you went away telling a lie.
you would bring so many toys.
So easily you promised to take your old mother to the village.
her son would come wrapped in the tricolour
and someday take her to the village..
you told a lie as you left.
When the time came to fulfil your duty,
smiling, you became a martyr for your country.
You made the tricolour your arrow,
you told a lie as you left.
you left false promises in our eyes.
you told a lie as you left.
I have neither complaint nor grievance,
I am proud to be a soldier’s wife.
But mine is a woman’s heart....
You forgot your promises to the children,
you took your old mother’s tears to the village.
You left the colour white as your gift to me.
you told a lie as you left.

illustration.alt: An Odisha home with a blue door, earthen courtyard and threshold drawings.
